name: Khouribga
source: ANCFCC (Agence Nationale de la Conservation Foncière, du Cadastre et de la Cartographie), including the Khouribga local conservation and cadastre offices

queries.query: Khouribga Morocco official cadastral map parcel GIS ANCFCC
queries.result: Found the official ANCFCC cadastral mandate and products pages, the official online cadastral-plan request page, the official external-services directory listing Khouribga offices, and the official cartographic catalogue listing Khouribga products.

queries.query: خريبكة المغرب الخريطة العقارية المسح العقاري الوكالة الوطنية للمحافظة العقارية
queries.result: Arabic ANCFCC pages and the official Arabic external-services directory were found. The directory lists Khouribga conservation and cadastral offices; no public parcel-feature API or downloadable Khouribga parcel geometry was verified.

officialAndRelevantLeads.scope: Khouribga local conservation and cadastral offices
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Lists Conservation Foncière at Boulevard Mohamed VI, BP 193, and Cadastre at Avenue Mohamed VI, BP 1, with separate official phone/fax contacts. This is local custodian evidence, not a parcel feed.
Officially describes ANCFCC responsibility for establishing and maintaining the national cadastre, cadastral archives, and making cadastral data available digitally or analogically.
Describes cadastral-plan and mappe-cadastrale products; mappe products are tied to Lambert and urban mappe scale is described as 1/2000. No open feature-service endpoint is advertised.

Indexed catalogue entries list Khouribga map products at 1/10,000 and 1/7,500, dated 2017. The live request returned the ANCFCC maintenance page in this environment, so the PDF bytes were not independently retrieved.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: The official online cadastral-plan request route returned an ANCFCC portal-maintenance HTML page rather than the form/service. No login, CAPTCHA bypass, credentials, private token, or unsafe field request was attempted.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.status: HTTP 200 maintenance HTML instead of PDF
requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: The official catalogue URL resolved to the same maintenance page from the shell. Indexed official search evidence was recorded, but no geometry or schema was extracted.
Khouribga local Conservation Foncière and Cadastre offices were identified. This qualifies registryFound=true but does not qualify a public anonymous parcel API.
